content.text:
The image shows an approved enemy sprite from the NES game Mega Man 2 (Capcom), enlarged: each square block is
ONE pixel, and the sprite is 20 x 28 pixels.

The enemy: A small floating robot squid, Blooper-like, that swims along at and after Mega Man in pulses (tentacles gather, then thrust). It is a swimming mine: when it gets close its eyes flash red, then it explodes.

Draw the SECOND frame of its swim animation: the stroke pose: the tentacles flare out wide (spread apart, tips curling outward) as it pushes; the mantle and eyes stay the same, at most 1 pixel higher.

Hard rules:
- It must be the SAME sprite: same character, same colours, same outline, same eyes and face, same pixel size
  (each pixel the same enlarged square block as in the input), about the same 20 x 28
  pixel footprint, same position on the canvas. Change ONLY what the motion needs.
- Real NES pixel art: clean square pixel blocks, no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur or new colours.
- The sprite alone on the same plain flat grey-blue background. No text, no frame, no second sprite.
